patterns.text: ~~vault is CLI-only~~ — CLOSED: `api` binary serves 14 HTTP endpoints at port 8255 wrapping vault commands
vault binary is Python — API server in Python maintains single-language runtime
8 + 255 = MAGIC dimension count + full score. Memorable, unique.
API stores no state — all truth in VAULT. Restart loses nothing.
Bearer token auth enforced on privileged endpoints (/wallet, /timeline, /transfer, /spend, /settle, /verify) — public endpoints unauthenticated
CORS origins governed: canonic.org, hadleylab.org, api.canonic.org — never wildcard
In-memory per-IP rate limiting: 60 req/min — returns 429 when exceeded
SIGTERM handler sets _shutting_down flag, returns 503, drains in-flight requests via server.shutdown()
Exponential backoff with jitter on GitHub and Stripe calls — max 3 attempts
Stripe webhook signature verified via HMAC-SHA256 before processing checkout.session.completed events
